citation: Classified advertisement, 'To rent—215 E. 21st-st., ... furnished, large, light room'. Chicago Daily Tribune, 23 July 1904 (vol. 63 no. 176).
author: Chicago Daily Tribune
locator: The issue's OCR text (per_chicago-daily-tribune_1904-07-23_63_176), the classified columns; the OCR runs neighbouring advertisements together, so only the words quoted in the note are read from it.
rights_note: A United States newspaper of 1904; public domain.
access_notes: Found by the Internet Archive's full-text search for the street address and read in the issue's OCR text for T-3013 on 2026-10-23; the page image was not consulted.
note: A furnished room to let at 215 East 21st Street three weeks after the scene's date: the lot held a dwelling in July 1904. In 1910 the trade directories put the Security Demountable Rim Co. at 215-217 East 21st Street.
what_it_supplies: that 215 East 21st Street was a dwelling letting rooms in July 1904
